name: Wake Me When Limits Reset Onesie
description: A full adult zip-front hooded onesie concept in washed black with bone chest lettering, acid hood lining and a token meter at the thigh. The slogan is arranged around the zipper.
alt: Full-length black adult hooded onesie with long sleeves, open ankle cuffs, acid hood lining, and bone text reading WAKE ME WHEN LIMITS RESET.
prompt:
Create one exceptional premium apparel concept mockup for the brand PROMPTDEPT: a FULL ADULT hooded zip-front lounge onesie, long sleeves, long separate legs ending in open ankle cuffs, photographed as a meticulously styled straight-on overhead flat lay. The entire single garment must be visible from top of hood to both ankle hems with generous clear margins on every side. Portrait 4:5 composition, warm pale gray studio surface, soft directional light, realistic subtle shadow, no props, no model, no hangers, no labels outside the garment. Adult proportions with long legs and a normal adult torso; clearly one connected garment, no footies, no baby romper, no diaper shape, no blanket hoodie, no two-piece outfit.

Garment: sophisticated washed near-black heavy lounge fabric with believable soft fabric texture, relaxed adult silhouette, real visible central gunmetal zipper from neck down to upper crotch, carefully sewn seams, generous hood with striking muted acid-chartreuse lining, refined tonal rib wrist and ankle cuffs. Two elegant low-profile front pocket openings at hips, one each side of zipper. Minimal useful construction details, premium but plausible.

Hero typography: large warm bone-white compact grotesk block lettering, beautifully art-directed on the upper chest in EXACTLY two readable lines: "WAKE ME WHEN" then "LIMITS RESET". The zipper passes through intentional generous gaps BETWEEN WHOLE WORDS, never through letters. First row left chest reads "WAKE ME", right chest reads "WHEN". Second row left chest reads "LIMITS", right chest reads "RESET". The words visually form the two continuous phrases across the full chest. Match balanced typographic weights and spacing so the zip is an intentional part of the layout. Crisp ink on fabric, no misspellings, no extra slogans. Below on one upper thigh, one simple compact acid-chartreuse horizontal empty token meter icon, composed of six outlined rectangular segments and only one small filled sliver. Tiny warm bone brand label "PROMPTDEPT" optional near a hip seam.

Strong editorial product photography, quietly witty internet-culture clothing with restraint, luxurious believable folds, rich black, bone, acid palette. This is a concept mockup, not a technical diagram. No factory claims, no material labels, no vendor logos, no TokenRot, no badges, no text floating around the garment. Priority: complete adult one-piece silhouette and perfectly readable exact lettering.

name: One More Prompt Onesie
description: An oxblood adult zip-front hooded onesie concept with warm cream cuffs, chest lettering and restrained Fair Isle bands of token meters and snowflakes.
alt: Full-length oxblood adult hooded onesie with cream cuffs, token-meter Fair Isle bands, and chest text reading ONE MORE PROMPT. THEN BED.
prompt:
Create one exceptional premium holiday-adjacent apparel concept mockup for PROMPTDEPT: a FULL ADULT hooded zip-front lounge onesie with long sleeves, full-length separate legs and open ankle cuffs. Precisely styled straight-on overhead flat lay, entire single connected garment visible from top of hood to both ankle hems, generous clear margins. Portrait 4:5 composition on a warm pale gray studio background, natural soft directional light and subtle shadows. No person, props, hanger or exterior captions. Adult proportions with long legs, natural adult torso and normal crotch. Never baby clothes, never diaper shape, no footies, no blanket hoodie, no two-piece set.

Garment: rich deep oxblood-burgundy lounge fabric with beautiful soft matte texture and realistic folds, relaxed premium adult silhouette, visible antique-silver zipper from neckline to upper crotch, substantial hood with oxblood lining, warm creamy rib wrist and ankle cuffs, subtle hip pocket entries at either side of zipper. Impeccable plausible seams and thoughtful functional details.

Hero chest typography in warm cream: EXACTLY two readable lines "ONE MORE PROMPT." then "THEN BED." Confident retro-leaning clean condensed sans-serif block lettering, excellent visual balance. Treat zipper as a purposeful gap between words: first line reads "ONE MORE" on left panel and "PROMPT." on right panel; second line reads "THEN" on left panel and "BED." on right panel. Leave a real central gutter for the zipper so NO LETTER is crossed or destroyed by the zip. Typography is integrated on the garment, not floating.

The subtle holiday crossover is two narrow restrained Fair Isle bands at the upper forearms and lower calves, alternating tiny warm-cream EMPTY token-meter icons and tiny geometric snowflake motifs. Each token meter is a simple unfilled segmented horizontal rectangle. Sparse refined pattern, visually small, plenty of oxblood negative space. No big reindeer or Santa imagery. Do not cover the chest words with any pattern. Optional very tiny cream "PROMPTDEPT" woven-style hem mark.

Exceptional tasteful editorial product photography, rich oxblood and cream palette, cozy late-night-builder humor translated into sophisticated adult apparel. Realistic drape and cloth texture. No claims about manufacturing or materials, no vendor logos, no TokenRot, no other slogans, no layout annotations. Priority: full adult one-piece silhouette, exact clear chest phrase, handsome sparse Fair Isle meter details.
